The Asana and Slack panes moved out of desk-look into two plugins of their own, desk-asana and desk-slack, so you install only the panes you use.

- `/desk-asana` and `/desk-slack` work as before, from the new `desk-asana` and `desk-slack` plugins in the same marketplace. Install the one you use; desk-look tells you once if it sees an Asana or Slack MCP server without the plugin
- desk-look itself now makes no network request of its own and calls no MCP server: the Asana REST calls and the Asana and Slack MCP calls live in the new plugins
- With desk-look installed, the new plugins follow its language, `/desk-fold` folds their panes too, and desk-slack's unread count still shows as the `✉ N` chip in desk-look's band
- `/desk-update` also updates desk-asana and desk-slack when they are installed
- The Asana personal access token and the Slack notification setting moved too: if you had set a token, set it again under `/plugin configure desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod`. desk-slack starts its conversation list afresh (the last 3 days, as read)

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`, and install desk-asana or desk-slack if you use those panes.
